auth.description: Authenticate with Azure Blob Storage using Account Name and Account Key

connectionString.description: You can obtain it from 'Security + networking -> Access Keys' menu.

listContainers.name: listContainers
listContainers.description: List Containers in the Azure Blob Storage account

includeDeleted.description: Whether to include deleted containers in the list

includeSystem.description: Whether to include system containers in the list

aiMetadata.description: Lists the containers in an Azure Blob Storage account. Use to discover available containers before reading or writing blobs; optionally narrow results with a name prefix and toggle inclusion of deleted or system containers. Read-only and idempotent.

containerName.description: The name for the newly created container

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new container in the Azure Blob Storage account with the given name. Use when you need a fresh container to store blobs. Not idempotent: the container name must not already exist or the call fails.

auth.description: Authenticate with Azure Blob Storage using Account Name and Account Key

connectionString.description: You can obtain it from 'Security + networking -> Access Keys' menu.

aiMetadata.description: Permanently deletes a container and all blobs it holds from the Azure Blob Storage account. Use only to remove an entire container; this is destructive and cannot be undone. Not idempotent: a second call against an already-deleted container fails.

listBlobs.name: listBlobs
listBlobs.description: List Blobs in the specified Azure Blob Storage container

auth.description: Authenticate with Azure Blob Storage using Account Name and Account Key

connectionString.description: You can obtain it from 'Security + networking -> Access Keys' menu.

includeSnapshots.description: Whether to include snapshots in the list

aiMetadata.description: Lists the blobs in a given container, returning each blob name with its properties and metadata. Use to enumerate or discover blobs before reading or processing them; optionally narrow by a name prefix and include snapshots. Read-only and idempotent.

createBlob.name: createBlob
createBlob.description: Creates a new Blob in the specified location

auth.description: Authenticate with Azure Blob Storage using Account Name and Account Key

connectionString.description: You can obtain it from 'Security + networking -> Access Keys' menu.

blobName.description: The name of the blob to create

file.description: The file to upload as a blob

tags.description: Optional tags to associate with the blob

aiMetadata.description: Uploads file data as a blob to the given container under the specified blob name, optionally attaching tags. Use to store or update a file in Azure Blob Storage. Idempotent on the blob name: re-uploading to the same name overwrites the existing blob rather than creating duplicates.

readBlob.name: readBlob
readBlob.description: Read the Blob at the specified lcoation

auth.description: Authenticate with Azure Blob Storage using Account Name and Account Key

connectionString.description: You can obtain it from 'Security + networking -> Access Keys' menu.

blobName.description: The name of the blob to read

aiMetadata.description: Downloads the blob at the given container and blob name and returns it as a file. Use to fetch the contents of a known blob for downstream processing; the blob name must already exist. Read-only and idempotent.

deleteBlob.name: deleteBlob
deleteBlob.description: Deletes the Blob at the specified location

auth.description: Authenticate with Azure Blob Storage using Account Name and Account Key

connectionString.description: You can obtain it from 'Security + networking -> Access Keys' menu.

blobName.description: The name of the blob to create

aiMetadata.description: Deletes the blob at the given container and blob name. Use to remove a single blob; this is destructive. Idempotent: it deletes only if the blob exists, so repeating the call against an already-deleted blob succeeds without error.

addTagsToBlob.name: addTagsToBlob
addTagsToBlob.description: Adds Tags to the Blob at the specified location

auth.description: Authenticate with Azure Blob Storage using Account Name and Account Key

connectionString.description: You can obtain it from 'Security + networking -> Access Keys' menu.

blobName.description: The name of the blob to add tags to

tags.description: The tags to add to the blob

keepExistingTags.description: Whether to keep existing tags on the blob

aiMetadata.description: Sets key-value tags on the blob at the given container and blob name. Operates in two modes: by default it replaces all existing tags with the supplied set, or with the keep-existing-tags option it merges the new tags onto the current ones. Use to label or categorize a blob for later tag-based search. Idempotent: applying the same tags yields the same final tag set.

findBlobs.name: findBlobs
findBlobs.description: Finds Blobs based on their tags

auth.description: Authenticate with Azure Blob Storage using Account Name and Account Key

connectionString.description: You can obtain it from 'Security + networking -> Access Keys' menu.

tags.description: The tags to filter blobs by

aiMetadata.description: Searches a container for blobs matching the supplied tag key-value pairs, returning the names of blobs whose tags satisfy all conditions (combined with AND). Use to locate blobs by tag rather than by name or prefix. Read-only and idempotent.
